notes: The %Hex2/%RGB macro pair (byte-identical to source) converts R,G,B integers to a CXrrggbb hex color code used to brand PROC REPORT/ODS styling. Source file defines the macros inline with a single %RGB(0,145,204) call embedded in a much larger PROC REPORT job with many undefined external macros/data; wrote a small caller (4 %RGB(...) calls + PROC PRINT) that exercises the macro pair in isolation, reusing the same brand-blue RGB(0,145,204) value from the original.
